intent: Parse a JSON string into a JSON::Value tree, in a strict mode that throws on malformed input and a permissive mode that does not.

objects.name: Parser
objects.role: two static entry points, read() (throws JSON::InvalidArgument) and readUnsafe() (swallows parse errors), both driving a rapidjson::Reader over a SAXHandler

naming_quality.note: readUnsafe clearly signals the risk relative to read
